conditions: The index subject is the language identified in the publisher's June 2024 edition.
limitations: The index lifecycle label active records the status of this identity in the index. The 15th edition is not asserted to be the latest edition.
Host facilities and engine or runtime conformance require separately scoped evidence. The catalog identity does not establish an unconditional JavaScript or JScript alias.

statement: Ecma International's ECMA-262 15th edition identifies ECMAScript as a general-purpose programming language and ECMAScript 2024 as the language specified by that edition.
